name: storage-v0.3.0
body:
This is storage release [storage-v0.3.0](https://github.com/rabbithole-app/v2/releases/tag/storage-v0.3.0) for commit [9f9b483481ec04cb9e8e721f2a88431df88fd63b](https://github.com/rabbithole-app/v2/commit/9f9b483481ec04cb9e8e721f2a88431df88fd63b).

## Release Notes

This release makes wallet funding and account navigation clearer in the storage app.

### Wallet

- You can now deposit supported Internet Computer tokens to your Principal ID.
- The wallet now shows which Internet Computer funds are on your Principal ID and which funds are already available in your Rabbithole balance.
- You can now withdraw supported wallet balances to Internet Computer, Base, and Solana wallets.

### Navigation

- Account settings, subscription, and wallet screens now support direct links.
- Refreshing or opening storage app links directly works more reliably.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/rabbithole-app/v2/compare/storage-v0.2.0...storage-v0.3.0

## Upgrade Compatibility

- Version: `0.3.0`
- Commit: `9f9b483481ec04cb9e8e721f2a88431df88fd63b`
- Argument strategy: `reuseInstallArgV1`
- Compatible from: `0.1.0`, `0.2.0`
- Frontend asset tree: `sha256:d09dd0da1ab852cc5e7d8bce562118d3286962797f9080c59eb17bfbc7cfd290`

## Wasm Verification

To rebuild the storage WASM module and verify its hash, run:

```sh
git checkout 9f9b483481ec04cb9e8e721f2a88431df88fd63b
npm install -g @icp-sdk/icp-cli@1.0.0 @icp-sdk/ic-wasm ic-mops@2.14.1
apps/backend/scripts/build-storage-release-wasm.sh
shasum -a 256 apps/backend/.icp/cache/artifacts/encrypted-storage
```

Expected storage WASM sha256: `14e540cbf2e92057471462671d837a7ea4766668364a22593cda6f40bf674373`

The machine-readable release contract is attached as `storage-release.json`.
